gloss_en: loosening the mouth of the mute — the Talmudic dictum (Sanhedrin 100a on "ve-alehu li-terufah") that the tzaddik's healing speech opens mute mouths, i.e., restores the power of holy speech; identified with the coupling of kissing (zivug ha-neshikin) that precedes and enables loosening the womb of the barren
